summary: Comprehensive UI theme testing of White Pearl + Golden Glossy theme with dark brown header. All features working correctly - dark brown header (#3D2314) with golden gradient text, light cream backgrounds (#FDFBF7), pearl-surface cards, gold-glossy buttons with hover effects, and proper navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Header correctly uses dark brown bg-[#3D2314] with nav-gold-text class for golden gradient text
nav-gold-text CSS class creates golden glossy effect with gradient and drop-shadow filter
gold-glossy class provides proper button styling with gradient and hover state change
pearl-surface class creates elegant white cards with subtle gold borders
All pages use consistent light cream background (#FDFBF7)
Mobile menu properly styled with dark brown background and golden text
Footer uses white background with gold accents for Quick Links and Contact headings
